up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records for the organism Rattus norvegicus. For each record, provide the substrate compound's canonical SMILES and structure, the substrate compound name, the metabolic conversion description, the enzyme name, and the enzyme target identifier.
sql:
WITH filtered_metabolism AS (
  SELECT
    met.met_id,
    met.substrate_record_id,
    met.met_conversion,
    met.enzyme_name,
    met.enzyme_tid,
    met.tax_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY met.met_id) AS rn
  FROM metabolism met
  WHERE met.tax_id = 10116
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cs.molfile,
  COALESCE(md.pref_name, cr.compound_name) AS compound_name,
  fm.met_conversion,
  fm.enzyme_name,
  td.chembl_id AS enzyme_target_chembl_id
FROM filtered_metabolism fm
JOIN compound_records cr ON fm.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON fm.enzyme_tid = td.tid;
